audit.why: 58.16% over 6967 games — the biggest sample in the slice — fully supports FAV at 4/10 with Malphite carry 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Sylas all seven rows. The packet chart gives Level 6 to Malphite and First item to Skill — and the page's own whys agree with the packet, not the chart: whys[4] says the banked R 'freezes your forward steps' and whys[5] says 'whoever catches the other overextended wins it'. Two rows currently render a claim the text underneath contradicts.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Malphite (4/10) and First item to Skill (5/10), as matched full/content pairs, with both full-layer whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force carried no cooldown despite being the field the entire page is organised around, and Granite Shield — the reason your first burst under-delivers — was never mentioned in the full layer.
audit.why: Kit: R 130/115/100s; Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges if he goes unhit, so an opening poke that pops it costs you nothing and makes the real trade land clean; Seismic Shard is a flat 8s that steals Move Speed for 3s; Ground Slam is a flat 7s dealing magic damage scaled off his armour.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns carries the 130/115/100 and the Granite Shield pop; report[5] carries the R timer and the Q's flat 8s with its 3s Move Speed steal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thunderclap is absent from the full layer, so nothing tells the reader his burst opens on an attack, not a cast.
audit.why: missingInteractions rules autoreset-burst-tell and onhit-itemization both key on Thunderclap (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s), which resets his auto and then puts aftershocks on subsequent attacks.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now names the reset and the wind-up cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.suspectNames flags 'Bait Unstoppable Force', 'Bank Unstoppable Force' and 'Land Unstoppable Force' as probable wrong names.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is Malphite's real R name. Three false positives, same pattern as the Kennen and Kayle entries — the matcher is scoring the leading verb into the distance.

edits.before: Hijack online — you now own a copy of Malphite's ultimate. The all-in math and every 2v2 swing your way.
edits.after: He banks Unstoppable Force here — 130s at rank 1, and the threat alone freezes your forward steps.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.
edits.after: Riftmaker lands, but so does his Sunfire or Thornmail — whoever catches the other overextended wins.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. It governs your forward steps. - E1 shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — 130/115/100s, usually banked for teamfights; Granite Shield eats 10% of his max HP, so open trades to pop it first. - E1 shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Track Malphite’s Unstoppable Force: Unstoppable engage — usually banked for teamfights, punish lane passivity. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Malphite’s Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1 and usually banked for teamfights. His Q is a flat 8s and steals your Move Speed for 3s.

edits.before: That’s Malphite’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His Thunderclap resets the auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

notes: The kit's grounding flag on Seismic Shard contradicts Riot's own description, which says only that it damages and steals Move Speed for 3s. I wrote the Move Speed steal and did NOT assert grounding — if Q really does ground, report[5] is where to add it. Same treatment as the percentHealth flag on Granite Shield: the description gives a flat 10%-max-HP absorb, which is what I wrote.
